# VanillaSSG

> High-performance, zero-hydration static site architecture built with pure HTML, Vanilla JavaScript, and Vite. Designed for 100/100 Lighthouse performance, sub-200-line modularity, and $0 edge hosting on Cloudflare Pages.

## Core Documentation & Resources
- [Architecture Blueprint](https://ssg.samseen.dev/items/item-one/): Detailed breakdown of zero-hydration static builds and performance metrics
- [Dynamic OG Vector Generator](https://ssg.samseen.dev/items/item-two/): Programmatic SVG card generation for social sharing
- [Cross-Referencing Engine](https://ssg.samseen.dev/items/item-three/): Automated bidirectional topic linking
- [Changelog](https://ssg.samseen.dev/changelog.html): Chronological version history, enhancements, and milestones
- [About VanillaSSG](https://ssg.samseen.dev/about.html): Background, architectural principles, and developer guide

## Machine-Readable Feeds & Catalogs
- [Sitemap](https://ssg.samseen.dev/sitemap.xml): Complete canonical index of all static routes and articles
- [RSS Feed](https://ssg.samseen.dev/feed.xml): Real-time XML content distribution feed
- [Robots Directives](https://ssg.samseen.dev/robots.txt): Crawler permissions and indexation parameters
